subject: Inference quality delta triage & next steps
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@cloudpeak.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2028 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Inference quality delta triage & next steps

Samir / Elena — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same picture.

Summary (what we observed on the bench vs Hyperscaler API):
- Hallucination delta: ~2.3% higher on their default-moderate config vs Redwood tuned baseline on our 1k prompt set (see attached delta-matrix).
- Latency: Hyperscaler outperforms on p95 for short prompts (~60ms better) but loses at >512 tokens; Redwood’s attention optimizations show advantage at scale.
- Token cost: list-price comparable once you include their egress + prefix caching assumptions; our batching + KV cache reduced effective per-token compute by ~18% in the test harness.

Asks / next tests we recommend:
1) Run a focused hallucination regression on your 200 critical prompts (we'll provide the harness and scoring rubric).
2) Shared A/B: Redwood (quantized profile A) vs Hyperscaler (their recommended low-latency profile) on your live-like workload for 48 hours.
3) Collect 50 anonymized problem-response pairs from your production corpus for us to run targeted probes (PII redaction steps in our onboarding doc).
4) If you can share 72 hours of latency traces for two peak windows we can run a routing / batching simulation that maps to your SLA.

Attachments: delta-matrix-v1.xlsx (diffs and prompt grouping), call-recording-20280621.mp3 (recording), sample probe rubric (in Drive link).

Proposed owners & timeline:
- Redwood provides harness + rubric: Marissa (2 business days)
- Bench runs and preliminary analysis: Ben (3 business days after harness)
- Joint A/B scheduling: Samir / CloudPeak ops to confirm windows (we can be flexible next week)

Next immediate step: Samir — can you confirm you can deliver the 200 prompt list and the two sample 48-hour windows by EOD Monday? If that's tight, tell us the earliest you can.

Thanks — Evelyn

--
Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
[evelyn.hart@redwood.com] | +1 (415) 555-0186

- We'll assemble the 200 prompt set; priority prompts first, full set by Tue EOD (we can start with the first 50 tomorrow).

Subject: Re: Inference quality delta triage & next steps

Evelyn / team — quick internal note on scope and runbook so we can respond to Samir's clarifying questions tomorrow:

1) Quantization / profile:
- "Quantized profile A" = 4-bit asymmetric (NF4-style) + per-channel scaling, KV-cache friendly layout used in our dedicated infra. We should call this out explicitly to CloudPeak and provide the config JSON in Drive.
- Baseline (for fairness): Redwood full-precision run, Redwood quantized A, Hyperscaler low-latency config (as they propose). We'll record per-prompt token-level logits for regression triage.

2) Hallucination scoring:
- Automatic flagging: model conf < 0.35 on authoritative prompts OR divergence from known-ground-truth > 0.6 (Jaccard/semantic overlap).
- Human review: 5% sample of flagged items, 2 senior annotators + adjudicator. We'll surface FPR/FNR metrics.

3) Resource & timeline estimate:
- Harness + config files (Marissa): 1 business day
- Run A/B for 48 hours (bench infra + collection): 2 business days
- Analysis + triage report: 2 business days
Total from prompt set receipt: ~5 business days for preliminary report.

4) Ops question: do we want to include a tail-latency stress test with 1k concurrent streams to check their autoscaling behavior? Might surface tricky degradation modes.

Action items I'm taking: I'll drop the quant A config in the Drive folder and draft the scoring rubric. Marissa — can you confirm harness location and set up an empty job for the 48h A/B so Samir can see the instance sizing options?

Ben
Principal Performance Engineer | Redwood Inference

- Samir: 6/27-6/28 windows work for Redwood; we'll reserve capacity and share exact instance sizing by EOD Tue. Please upload the 200 prompts in the Drive folder or paste a secure link; first 50 will be enough to unstick the bench.
- Ben / Marissa: please add the quant config JSON + scoring rubric to the Drive folder and share the harness link with Samir when ready. Include tail-latency stress test as optional checkbox for the A/B.
- I'll create the HubSpot task and attach CP-5421 so we have a single tracker.

I'll follow up with a short calendar invite (30m) to align on the A/B kickoff and data handoff. If anyone needs to escalate scope (more than 200 prompts or extended A/B), flag it and we'll route to Solutions leadership for decision.

Evelyn
